endpoint.description: `host:port` of one broker or bootstrap address.

sasl.description:
How the worker logs in to a `Kafka` cluster. Absent: `aws-msk-iam`
for `aws: true`, else `plain`.

tls.description:
TLS toward the broker. On by default; `false` is for local brokers only.
Left out of the snapshot when default, so components from before
Phase 11 (which reject unknown fields) still read it during an upgrade.

access.description:
`read` (SELECT) or `write` (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), on every
table in the listed schemas (default `public` for PostgreSQL).

DbRoleSpec.description: A database login role Limen creates and maintains (ADR-0015).

grants.description: Each entry is a database and the privileges the role gets in it.

admin_secret_arn.description: Secrets Manager ARN holding the admin credentials used for role bootstrap.

admin_user.description:
Role bootstrap (ADR-0015, ADR-0033): a dedicated admin login and the
file on the worker that holds its password.

bootstrap.description: Roles to create and the grants they get (bootstrap).

cluster_identifier.description:
Redshift (provisioned): the cluster to ask for temporary credentials
(`GetClusterCredentials`).

default_database.description: The database to use when the user doesn't name one.

insecure_dev.description:
Talk to the target without TLS. Refused unless the worker was started
with `--allow-insecure-db-targets` (the local compose profile).

normalize_literals.description: Replace literals in logged statement text with `?` (`audit.normalize_literals`).

password_dir.description:
Secret mode (ADR-0033): a directory on the worker with one file per DB
role, named for the role, holding its password. Used when `iam_auth` is false.

tls_ca_file.description:
PEM bundle on the worker that signs the target's certificate (for
example the RDS bundle). Without it the system roots are used.

tls_server_name.description:
The name the target's certificate must carry, when it differs from the
host in `endpoint` (an IP address, a `PrivateLink` name, a tunnel).

workgroup.description: Redshift Serverless: the workgroup to ask for credentials.

Delegated.description:
Marks a resource a bot writer completed from a profile. The worker refuses
the addresses `delegation::forbidden_address` names for it, and, when
these bounds are set, any address outside them.

profile.description: The profile it was built from.

KafkaSasl.description: The SASL mechanism the worker uses toward a Kafka cluster (ADR-0037).

oneOf.description: No SASL: an open listener, or mutual TLS alone.

MongoAuth.description: How the worker logs in to a MongoDB-compatible server (ADR-0035).

oneOf.description: `MONGODB-X509`: a client certificate and key per role in `credentials_dir`.

`MONGODB-AWS`: the worker's IAM identity (Atlas and `DocumentDB`).
Unverified against the real services.

MongoFlavor.description:
Where a MongoDB-compatible server runs, which decides how the worker will
authenticate (ADR-0018).

auth_source.description:
Where the users are defined (`authSource`). Default `admin`, or
`$external` for `x509` and `aws`.

credentials_dir.description:
A directory on the worker: `<role>` holds that role's password
(`scram`, `scram_sha1`) and `<role>.pem` its client certificate and
key (`x509`).

default_database.description: The database to use when the user doesn't name one.

endpoint.description:
`host:port`. A replica set member is enough: the worker follows the
primary the member names (no `mongodb+srv` resolution yet).

full_commands.description:
Keep the values of commands in the audit trail (`audit.full_commands`).
The default replaces every value in a filter, document, or pipeline
with `?` and keeps the shape.

insecure_dev.description:
Talk to the server without TLS. Only for `standard` servers, and refused
unless the worker runs with `--allow-insecure-db-targets`.

max_commands_per_second.description:
Most commands per second one session may send. Over it, commands wait
their turn (a burst of 100 passes at once), so a client in a loop can't
flood the audit trail. 0 is no limit.

tls_ca_file.description:
PEM bundle that signs the server's certificate. Required: for Atlas
use the system bundle, for `DocumentDB` the AWS global bundle.

tls_server_name.description:
The name the server's certificate must carry, when it differs from
the host in `endpoint`.

RedisAudit.description:
What a `redis.command` event may contain (ADR-0034). Values are never
logged unless `log_values` is set, and credential commands never are.

redact_keys.description: Replace key names with a hash, so the trail holds no ids or emails.

audit.description:
Left out of the snapshot when default, so components from before
Phase 7 (which reject unknown fields) still read it during an upgrade.

cache_name.description: The `ElastiCache` replication group ID, which names the IAM token's host.

tls.description: TLS toward the target. On by default; `false` is for local servers only.

SearchAudit.description:
What a `search.request` event may contain (ADR-0036). Request bodies are
never logged unless `log_bodies` is set, and never for security APIs.

log_query.description: Log query-string values, not only the parameter names.

redact_ids.description: Replace document ids in the path with a hash.

audit.description:
Left out of the snapshot when default, so components from before
Phase 10 (which reject unknown fields) still read it during an upgrade.

aws.description: An AWS-managed domain (`OpenSearch` Service), reached with `SigV4`.

tls.description: TLS toward the target. On by default; `false` is for local servers only.

host_key.description: Pinned host public key in OpenSSH format, if the target has no host certificate.

address.description: `host:port` of the app, as the worker reaches it.

host.description: The public host name users open, such as `grafana.apps.example.com`.

identity_headers.description:
Explicitly enable trusted identity headers for an app that consumes
Limen's signed identity assertion. Disabled by default.

insecure_dev.description:
Permit plain HTTP only for a development target, and only when the
worker is started with its insecure web-target opt-in.

tls_ca_file.description: CA bundle on the worker used to verify the HTTPS upstream.

tls_server_name.description: TLS certificate name when it differs from the address host.

description: Exactly one of the protocol sections must be set.

delegated.description:
Set by the control plane on a resource built from a profile (ADR-0042
§5). Left out otherwise, so components from before Phase 14 still read
every other resource.

worker_selector.description: Labels a worker must carry to serve this resource.
